capabilities: Analyze the active note with live word counts, goal progress, a word cloud, and category charts
Track writing history with totals, streaks, trends, and an inspectable calendar over configurable date ranges
Set a daily word goal and edit the built-in and extra word lists behind each topic, feeling, and mindset category
Index Daily Notes plus additional journal folders using filename date formats or creation timestamps
Keep all analysis local, storing counts and settings in the vault without sending note text anywhere
extras: Installation is via manual download of a release zip (or main.js, manifest.json, styles.css); requires Obsidian 1.5.7 or later. The README warns that copying or syncing files can reset creation timestamps, which affects dating in creation-timestamp mode, and that the language charts count literal English word cues only, without context or non-English semantic analysis.
problem: Obsidian's word count only works on the current note, so there is no built-in way to see writing volume, goals, streaks, or vocabulary patterns over time across journal entries.
summary: Local writing analytics plugin that shows live word counts, word clouds, goal streaks, and topic and tone trends across Daily Notes and journal folders.
